Borkeo EMR v50.5.0 - IPD layout, editable SOAP draft and pregnancy history
Baseline 50.4.0, commit 8272cbb65387da67fdbdb805bfb78fde85d12f44. Already installed: do not apply twice.
1. Take code-only and online database backups. Stop only the identified EMR.
2. Preserve later customizations, .env, all live databases, uploads, attachments,
   API keys/grants, password exports, backups, .gitignore and user workspace files.
3. Parse BEGIN_JSON_FILES. Write each decoded content string as UTF-8/LF to its
   file. Verify bytes and SHA-256. Do not write JSON escapes literally.
4. Receiver overrides: package 50.5.0 -> 50.4.0; visible/server v50.5 -> v50.4.
   Preserve shared cache versions and both installations' original data paths.
5. Run npm test and npm run check:khmer in a disposable synthetic copy. Check
   doctor/nurse permissions, original triage preservation, Save/reopen, remote
   read-only review, desktop/mobile and print. Restart original launchers.
6. Refresh with Ctrl+F5. SOAP drafts use entered current-visit fields and must be
   reviewed before Save/signing. Manual edits persist until explicit regeneration.
Past pregnancy does not establish current pregnancy. Unknown remains unknown.
Drug catalogue, stock, prices, dose tables and interaction rules are unchanged.
Medscape is a fixed manual reference link only: no API, scraping, automated CDS,
stored Medscape password, external AI or patient-data query is included.
No database migration, automatic clinical import or API pairing is included.
Restore archived code into a NEW folder only; never overwrite live data/secrets.
See docs/development/IPD_SOAP_HISTORY_V505_VALIDATION.md for evidence and limits.

    "content": "# Clinical review - values a doctor must confirm\n\nClinical lists and rules used by the EMR that are not program logic. Change\nthem only after a doctor has confirmed them. Interaction and maximum-dose\ntables (Phase 6) will start empty.\n\n## v41.0 (Phase 4) - structured allergy record, problem list, resuscitation status\n\nFile: `server/clinical-options.json` (codes are stored; screen labels are\ntranslated through `docs/translations-needed.csv`).\n\n| List | Codes | Please confirm |\n|---|---|---|\n| Allergy type | `drug`, `food`, `other` | Are other types needed (e.g. latex, contrast)? |\n| Allergy severity | `mild`, `moderate`, `severe`, `life-threatening`, `unknown` | Keep this scale? |\n| Resuscitation status | `full`, `dnr` | Are other statuses needed (e.g. limited treatment)? |\n\nRules (in code, listed here so they can be checked):\n\n- **Risk flags** in the patient banner show only what is already recorded:\n  every allergy with severity `severe` or `life-threatening`, and a `dnr`\n  resuscitation status. No other risk (falls, pressure sores, isolation...)\n  is calculated. Tell us which risk flags you want and from which fields.\n- **\"No allergy\" words** in the record's free-text drug-allergy box\n  (ប្រតិកម្មនឹងថ្នាំ): the Khmer word the banner always used, `no`, `none`,\n  `nil`, `NKA`, `NKDA`, `neg`, `negative`, `-`. Any other text counts as an\n  allergy and is shown in red. An empty box (and no structured allergy) is\n  shown as \"Allergy not recorded\", not as \"no allergy\".\n- **Who may change** allergies, problems and resuscitation status: doctors\n  only (`CLINICAL_SUMMARY_WRITE_ROLES` in `server/clinical-summary.mjs`).\n  Everyone who can open the record can read them.\n- **Allergies and problems follow the person** across visits (same Health\n  ID); without a Health ID they stay with that visit. Resuscitation status\n  belongs to the current visit only.\n- **Nothing is deleted**: removing an allergy needs a reason and keeps the\n  row (who, when, why); a resolved problem can be made active again.\n\n## v41.1 (Phase 5) - display rules by age and sex\n\nFile: `server/clinical-options.json`, `displayRules` (ages in completed years,\nlimits included). Age comes from the date of birth, else the typed age (the\nsame reading as the triage child growth panel). When age or sex is unknown,\nthe section is shown. Hiding never clears a field, and a section that holds a\nsaved value is always shown.\n\n| Rule | Setting | Value | Please confirm |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Immunization list (ចាក់ថ្នាំបង្ការ) | `immunizationMaxAge` | shown 0-14, hidden from 15 | |\n| Smoking / alcohol / drug questions | `substanceUseMinAge` | shown from 10 | |\n| Paediatric section | `paediatricMaxAge` | 0-14 | |\n| Head circumference (in Growth) | `headCircumferenceMaxAge` | 0-2 | Up to which age do you measure it? |\n| Tetanus vaccine status | `tetanusFemaleMinAge` / `tetanusFemaleMaxAge` / `tetanusWhenPregnant` | females 15-49, and pregnant patients | |\n| Ob/gyn history | `obgynFemaleMinAge` / `obgynYoungerWhenPregnant` | females 15 and over; under 15 only when pregnant or in the obstetric ward (owner, 2026-10-21); a \"show\" button for any other female; never for males | |\n| Obstetric ward codes | `obstetricWardCodes` | `obstetric`, `gyneco-obstetric` | |\n\n\"Pregnant\" means: the patient is in an obstetric ward, or an EDD is written in\nthe ob/gyn history. In v50.5, separate structured past-pregnancy, current-visit\npregnancy and breastfeeding fields were added. Past pregnancy does not imply\ncurrent pregnancy. These new documentation fields do not alter the existing\ndisplay-rule thresholds or medication tables; Medscape remains a manual reference.\n\nTetanus vaccine status options (in `protected/EMR.html`): TT1, TT2, TT3, TT4,\nTT5, No dose, Unknown, plus the last dose date. Please confirm the list.\n\n## v41.2 (Phase 6) - medication administration record and prescribing warnings\n\n- **Who records doses**: nurses and midwives of the patient's ward (`MAR_WRITE_ROLES`, `server/medication-safety.mjs`). Doctors and others read.\n- **Held / Refused** always need a reason. A time more than 5 minutes in the future is refused. A recorded dose cannot be recorded twice; a correction keeps the old entry (crossed out, with who and why).\n- **Allergy warning**: from the structured allergy record only (Phase 4), all allergy types. A medicine matches when it contains the allergy substance, or its first word (4+ letters) appears in the substance. Example: \"Penicillin V 500mg\" matches \"Penicillin\"; \"Amoxicillin\" does NOT match \"Penicillin\" (no class rules). The old free-text drug-allergy box is not checked automatically. Please confirm, or ask for drug-class rules.\n- **Duplicate warning**: same first word (4+ letters) as another medicine in the same prescription (admission, daily note or OPD). Medicines from earlier daily notes are not compared.\n- **Interaction and maximum-dose tables** (`/admin/drug-safety`): EMPTY. Only an administrator can add rows. Enter only a list approved by a doctor. Maximum per day = morning + afternoon + evening + night amounts; checked only when the unit matches or no unit is set.\n- **Override**: doctors only, reason required; stored with the warnings and audited (`PRESCRIBING_WARNING_OVERRIDDEN`).\n\n## v41.3 (Phase 7) - consents, surgery, anaesthesia and transfusion forms\n\n- **Consent and refusal wording**: the owner's approved text (docs/phase7-consent-drafts.md, applied 2026-10-21). <p>នៅពេលស្វែងរកការព្យាបាលអតិថិជនមានសិទ្ធិដូចខាងក្រោម៖</p>\n\n                    <p><strong>១) សិទ្ធិស្មើភាព និងសិទ្ធិមិនរើសអើងគ្រប់បែបយ៉ាង</strong></p>\n                    <ul>\n                        <li>សិទ្ធិទទួលបានសេវាប្រកបដោយគុណភាពទៅតាមស្តង់ដារជាតិ ដែលបានកំណត់ដោយមិនប្រកាន់ពូជសាសន៍ សញ្ជាតិ\n                            ពណ៌សម្បុរ សាសនា ភាសា អាយុ ភេទ ស្ថានភាពគ្រួសារ ស្ថានភាពសេដ្ឋកិច្ច ស្ថានភាពសង្គម\n                            និងនិន្នាការនយោបាយឡើយ ។</li>\n                    </ul>\n\n                    <p><strong>២) សិទ្ធិក្នុងការទទួលបានព័ត៌មាន និងការអប់រំសុខភាព</strong></p>\n                    <ul>\n                        <li>មានសិទ្ធិទទួលបានព័ត៌មានអំពីសេវាដែលមាន ម៉ោងពេលធ្វើការ ចរាចរអតិថិជន\n                            និងតំលៃសេវាក៏ដូចជាការលើកលែងបង់ថ្លៃ ព្រមទាំងរបៀបរបបនៃការបង់ថ្លៃផងដែរ ។</li>\n                        <li>សិទ្ធិក្នុងការស្នើសុំនូវឯកសារសង្ខេបអំពីរោគវិនិច្ឆ័យ ការថែទាំព្យាបាល\n                            និងលទ្ធផលនៃការវិភាគអមវេជ្ជសាស្រ្ត នៅពេលចាកចេញពីមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាល ។</li>\n                        <li>សិទ្ធិទទួលបាននូវការអប់រំសុខភាព ជាពិសេសទាក់ទងទៅនឹងការការពារ និង ការលើកកម្ពស់សុខភាព ។</li>\n                    </ul>\n\n                    <p><strong>៣) សិទ្ធិ ការទទួលបានការថែទាំ និងព្យាបាលជំងឺ</strong></p>\n                    <ul>\n                        <li>សិទ្ធិក្នុងការទទួលបានការថែទាំព្យាបាលដែលសមស្របទៅតាមតម្រូវការសុខភាពរបស់គាត់ទាំងការការពារ\n                            និងលើកកម្ពស់សុខភាពផងដែរ។\n និងដោយភាពថ្លៃថ្នូរសមស្របទៅនឹងទំនៀមទម្លាប់ និងសីលធម៌ នៅអំឡុងពេលធ្វើរោគវិនិច្ឆ័យ និងពេលព្យាបាល\n                            ។</li>\n                    </ul>\n\n                    <p><strong>៤) សិទ្ធិក្នុងការរក្សាភាពអាថ៌កំបាំង</strong></p>\n                    <ul>\n                        <li>មានសិទ្ធិទទួលបាននូវការរក្សាអាថ៌កំបាំងនូវរាល់ព័ត៌មានទាំងអស់របស់គាត់\n <p><strong>៥) សិទ្ធិ ក្នុងការទទួលបានភាពឯកជន</strong></p>\n                    <ul>\n                        <li>អតិថិជនដែលមកពិនិត្យសំរាកព្យាបាលនៅមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាលមានសិទ្ធិទទួលបានភាពបិទបាំង\n                            សមរម្យនៅមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាលដែលគាត់ប្រើប្រាស់ជាពិសេសនៅពេលដែលអ្នកផ្តល់សេវាធ្វើការ\n                            ពិនិត្យរាងកាយនិងនៅពេលព្យាបាល ។</li>\n                    </ul>\n\n                    <p><strong>៦) សិទ្ធិក្នុងការជ្រើសរើស និងការយល់ព្រម</strong></p>\n                    <ul>\n                        <li>អតិថិជនអាចមានសិទ្ធិក្នុងការជ្រើសរើស ឬផ្លាស់ប្តូរមូលដ្ឋានសុខាភិបាល isFinite(ageData.totalMonths) ? ageData.totalMonths : null;\n            if (totalMonths === null || totalMonths < 0) return VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES[VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES.length - 1];\n            for (var i = 0; i < VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES.length; i++) {\n                if (totalMonths < VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES[i].maxMonths) return VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES[i];\n            }\n            return VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES[VITAL_REFERENCE_RANGES.length - 1];\n        }\n\n        function assessVitalValue(fieldName, rawValue, ageData) {\n            var value = nursingNumber(rawValue);\n            var reference = getPatientVitalRange(ageData || getExactAge());\n            var range = fieldName === 'spo2' ? [95, 100] : reference[fieldName];\n            if (value === null) return { hasValue: false, abnormal: false, value: null, range: range || null };\n            var abnormal = !range || value < range[0] || value > range[1];\n            return { hasValue: true, abnormal: abnormal, value: value, range: range };\n        }\n\n        function assessBloodPressure(rawSystolic, rawDiastolic, ageData) {\n            var systolic = nursingNumber(rawSystolic);\n            var diastolic = nursingNumber(rawDiastolic);\n            var reference = getPatientVitalRange(ageData || getExactAge());\n            if (systolic === null || diastolic === null) {\n                return { complete: false, abnormal: false, systolic: systolic, diastolic: diastolic, pulsePressure: null, reasons: [], systolicRange: reference.bpSys, diastolicRange: reference.bpDia || null };\n            }\n\n            var pulsePressure = systolic - diastolic;\n            var reasons = [];\n            if (systolic <= diastolic) reasons.push('Invalid systolic/diastolic order');\n            if (systolic < reference.bpSys[0] || systolic > reference.bpSys[1]) reasons.push('Systolic BP outside age range');\n            if (reference.bpDia && (diastolic < reference.bpDia[0] || diastolic > reference.bpDia[1])) reasons.push('Diastolic BP outside adult range');\n            if (pulsePressure <= NURSING_BP_RULES.narrowPulsePressure) reasons.push('Narrow pulse pressure');\n            if (pulsePressure >= NURSING_BP_RULES.widePulsePressure) reasons.push('Wide pulse pressure');\n\n            return {\n                complete: true,\n                abnormal: reasons.length > 0,\n                systolic: systolic,\n                diastolic: diastolic,\n                pulsePressure: pulsePressure,\n                reasons: reasons,\n                systolicRange: reference.bpSys,\n                diastolicRange: reference.bpDia || null\n            };\n        }\n\n        function applyVitalInputState(input, assessment) {\n            if (!input) return;\n            input.classList.remove('vital-normal', 'vital-abnormal');\n            if (assessment && assessment.range) {\n                input.title = (currentLang === 'khmer' ? // ==========================================\n        var partographLoadPromise = null;\n\n        function setPartographEmbedStatus(message, isError) {\n            var status = Error('Partograph payload is missing.');\n\n            var encoded = payloadNode.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g, '');\n            if (!encoded) throw new Error('Partograph payload is empty.');\n\n            var binary = window.atob(encoded);\n            var bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);\n            for (var index = 0; index < binary.length; index += 1) {\n                bytes[index] = binary.charCodeAt(index);\n            }\n\n            if (window.TextDecoder) {\n                return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);\n            }\n\n            var escaped = '';\n            for (var byteIndex = 0; byteIndex < bytes.length; byteIndex += 1) {\n                escaped += '%' + bytes[byteIndex].toString(16).padStart(2, '0');\n            }\n            return decodeURIComponent(escaped);\n        }\n\n        function loadPartographFrame() {\n            var frame = document.getElementById('partograph_frame');\n            var loading = document.getElementById('partograph_loading');\n            if (!frame) return Promise.reject(new Error('Partograph frame was not found.'));\n            if (frame.dataset.ready === 'true') return Promise.resolve(frame);\n            if (partographLoadPromise) return partographLoadPromise;\n\n            frame.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');\n            if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-hidden');\n            setPartographEmbedStatus('');\n\n            partographLoadPromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {\n                var html;\n                try {\n                    html = decodePartographPayload();\n                } catch (error) {\n                    partographLoadPromise = null;\n                    if (loading) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');\n                    frame.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');\n                    setPartographEmbedStatus('មិនអាចបើក Partograph បាន។', true);\n                    reject(error);\n                    return;\n                }\n\n                var handleLoad = function () {\n                    frame.contentDocument.querySelectorAll('[onclick*=\"print()\"]').forEach(function (button) {\n                        button.removeAttribute('onclick');\n                        button.addEventListener('click',printPartograph);\n                    });\n                    frame.dataset.ready = 'true';\n                    frame.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');\n                    if (loading) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');\n                    resolve(frame);\n                };\n\n                var handleError = function () {\n                    partographLoadPromise = null;\n                    frame.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');\n                    if (loading) loading.classList.add('is-hidden');\n                    setPartographEmbedStatus('មិនអាចបើក Partograph បាន។', true);\n                    reject(new Error('Partograph frame failed to load.'));\n                };\n\n                frame.addEventListener('load', handleLoad, { once: true });\n                frame.addEventListener('error', handleError, { once: true });\n                frame.srcdoc = html;\n            });\n\n            return partographLoadPromise;\n        }\n\n        function getEmrFieldValue(id) {\n            var field = document.getElementById(id);\n            return field && typeof field.value === }\n\n        function createMedicationTimingDetailRow(mainRow, prefix) {\n            if (!mainRow || !mainRow.parentNode) return null;\n            var detailRow = document.createElement('tr');\n            detailRow.className = 'rx-timing-detail-row ' + prefix + '-timing-detail-row';\n            detailRow.setAttribute('data-mode', 'protocol');\n            detailRow.innerHTML = `\n                <td colspan=\"10\">\n                    <div class=\"rx-timing-panel\">\n                        <div class=\"med-protocol-head\">\n                            <span><i class=\"fa-solid 1 : 0);\n            }, 0);\n            return { 1: 'qd_m', 2: 'bid', 3: 'tid', 4: 'qid' }[activeCount] || '';\n        }\n\n        function getMedicationDoseAmount(mainRow) {\n            if (!mainRow) return '';\n            var prefix = getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow);\n            var doseField = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-dose');\n            if (doseField && normalizeNursingCellText(doseField.value)) return normalizeNursingCellText(doseField.value);\n            var legacyField = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-m, .' + prefix + '-a, .' + prefix + '-e, .' + prefix + '-n');\n            return legacyField ? parseFloat(qHoursField.value) : 0;\n                return qHours > 0 ? 24 / qHours : 0;\n            }\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        function calculateMedicationQuickTotal(mainRow) {\n            if (!mainRow) return;\n            var prefix = getMedicationRowPrefix(mainRow);\n            var totalField = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-total');\n            if (!totalField) return;\n            var dose = parseFloat(getMedicationDoseAmount(mainRow)) || 0;\n            var daysField = mainRow.querySelector('.' + prefix + '-d');\n            var days = daysField ? parseFloat(daysField.value) || 0 : 0;\n            var scheduleType = getMedicationScheduleType(mainRow);\n            var total = 0;\n            if (scheduleType === 'protocol') {\n                var timing = getMedicationTimingData(mainRow, '');\n                var doseSequence = String(timing.protocolDose || '').match(/\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?/g) || [];\n                var maxDoses = parseInt(timing.protocolMaxDoses, 10) || doseSequence.length;\n                for (var index = 0; index < maxDoses; index++) {\n                    total += parseFloat(doseSequence[Math.min(index, Math.max(0, doseSequence.length - 1))]) || dose;\n                }\n            } else if (scheduleType === 'qh') {\n                var qHoursField = mainRow.querySelector('.med-q-hours');\n                var qHours = qHoursField ? parseFloat(qHoursField.value) : 0;\n                total = dose && days && qHours > 0 ? Math.ceil((days * 24) / qHours) * dose : 0;\n            } else {\n                total = dose * getMedicationDailyFrequency(mainRow) * days;\n            }\n            // v42.5: no number of medicine yet: the total stays empty (never 0 or NaN).\n            totalField.value = total && isFinite(total) ? String(Math.round(total * 100) / 100) : '';\n        }\n\n        function formatMedicationScheduleLabel(scheduleType, qHours, language) {\n            var khmer = (language || currentLang) === 'khmer';\n            if (scheduleType === 'qd_m') return khmer ?        return formatNursingMedicationDate(date) + '/' + date.getFullYear() + ' ' + formatNursingMedicationTime(date);\n        }\n\n        function getNursingMedicationDateKey(date) {\n            if '0');\n        }\n\n        function buildIntervalMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, intervalHours, durationDays, capacity) {\n            var doseCount = intervalHours > 0 && isFinite(durationDays) && durationDays > 0\n                ? Math.ceil((durationDays * 24) / intervalHours)\n                : (intervalHours > 0 ? capacity : 1);\n            doseCount = Math.min(256, Math.max(1, doseCount));\n            var states = [];\n            var previousDateKey = '';\n            for (var index = 0; index < doseCount; index++) {\n                var scheduledTime = new Date(startTime.getTime() + (index * intervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000));\n                var dateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(scheduledTime);\n                states.push({\n                    scheduledAt: scheduledTime.toISOString(),\n                    actualAt: '',\n                    showDate: index === 0 || dateKey !== previousDateKey\n                });\n                previousDateKey = dateKey;\n            }\n            return states;\n        }\n\n        function buildNursingMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, frequency, durationDays, capacity) {\n            return buildIntervalMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, getNursingMedicationIntervalHours(frequency), durationDays, capacity);\n        }\n\n        function getMedicationWardTimes(scheduleType) {\n            if (scheduleType === 'bid') return [[6, 0], [19, 0]];\n            if (scheduleType === 'tid') return [[6, 0], [14, 0], [19, 0]];\n            return [];\n        }\n\n        function buildWardRoundMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, scheduleType, durationDays, capacity) {\n            var wardTimes = getMedicationWardTimes(scheduleType);\n            if (!wardTimes.length) return [];\n            var hasDuration = isFinite(durationDays) && durationDays > 0;\n            var endTime = hasDuration ? new Date(startTime.getTime() + durationDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) : null;\n            var stateLimit = Math.min(256, hasDuration ? Math.ceil(durationDays * wardTimes.length) + wardTimes.length : capacity);\n            stateLimit = Math.max(1, stateLimit);\n            var dayCursor = new Date(startTime.getFullYear(), startTime.getMonth(), startTime.getDate());\n            var states = [];\n            var previousDateKey = '';\n            var safetyDays = 0;\n            while (states.length < stateLimit && safetyDays < 370) {\n                for (var timeIndex = 0; timeIndex < wardTimes.length && states.length < stateLimit; timeIndex++) {\n                    var scheduledTime = new Date(dayCursor.getFullYear(), dayCursor.getMonth(), dayCursor.getDate(), wardTimes[timeIndex][0], wardTimes[timeIndex][1], 0, 0);\n                    if (scheduledTime.getTime() < startTime.getTime()) continue;\n                    if (endTime && scheduledTime.getTime() >= endTime.getTime()) return states;\n                    var dateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(scheduledTime);\n                    states.push({\n                        scheduledAt: scheduledTime.toISOString(),\n                        actualAt: '',\n                        showDate: states.length === 0 || dateKey !== previousDateKey\n                    });\n                    previousDateKey = dateKey;\n                }\n                dayCursor.setDate(dayCursor.getDate() + 1);\n                safetyDays++;\n            }\n            return states;\n        }\n\n        function parseMedicationIntervalItems(value) {\n            var intervals = [];\n            var source = String(value || '');\n            var expression = /(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*(hours?|hrs?|hr|h|ម៉ោង|minutes?|mins?|min|m|នាទី)/gi;\n            var match;\n            while ((match = expression.exec(source)) !== null) {\n                var amount = parseFloat(match[1]);\n                var unit = String(match[2] || '').toLocaleLowerCase();\n                var isHours = /^(h|hr|hrs|hour|hours|ម៉ោង)$/.test(unit);\n                if (isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {\n                    intervals.push({ value: match[1], unit: isHours ? 'hours' : 'minutes', minutes: isHours ? amount * 60 : amount });\n                }\n            }\n            return intervals;\n        }\n\n        function parseMedicationIntervalSequence(value) {\n            return parseMedicationIntervalItems(value).map(function (interval) { return interval.minutes; });\n        }\n\n        function getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order) {\n            var amount = parseFloat(order && order.protocolRepeatValue);\n            if (!isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return 0;\n            return order.protocolRepeatUnit === 'minutes' ? amount : amount * 60;\n        }\n\n        function buildProtocolMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order, capacity) {\n            var intervals = parseMedicationIntervalSequence(order.protocolIntervals);\n            var repeatMinutes = getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order);\n            var maxDoses = parseInt(order.protocolMaxDoses, 10);\n            if (!isFinite(maxDoses) || maxDoses < 1) maxDoses = 0;\n            var stopAt = order.protocolStopAt ? new Date(order.protocolStopAt) : null;\n            if (stopAt && isNaN(stopAt.getTime())) stopAt = null;\n            var openEnded = repeatMinutes > 0 && !maxDoses && !stopAt;\n            var safetyLimit = Math.min(256, maxDoses || (repeatMinutes && stopAt ? 256 : (openEnded ? capacity : intervals.length + 1)));\n            safetyLimit = Math.max(1, safetyLimit);\n            var states = [];\n            var currentTime = new Date(startTime.getTime());\n            var previousDateKey = '';\n            for (var index = 0; index < safetyLimit; index++) {\n                var dateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(currentTime);\n                states.push({\n                    scheduledAt: currentTime.toISOString(),\n                    actualAt: '',\n                    showDate: index === 0 || dateKey !== previousDateKey\n                });\n                previousDateKey = dateKey;\n                if (maxDoses && states.length >= maxDoses) break;\n                var intervalMinutes = index < intervals.length ? intervals[index] : repeatMinutes;\n                if (!intervalMinutes) break;\n                var nextTime = new Date(currentTime.getTime() + intervalMinutes * 60000);\n                if (stopAt && nextTime.getTime() > stopAt.getTime()) break;\n                currentTime = nextTime;\n            }\n            return states;\n        }\n\n        function buildMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order, capacity) {\n            if (order && order.timingMode === 'protocol') {\n                return buildProtocolMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order, capacity);\n            }\n            if (order && (order.scheduleType === 'bid' || order.scheduleType === 'tid')) {\n                return buildWardRoundMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order.scheduleType, parseFloat(order.d), capacity);\n            }\n            if (order && order.scheduleType === 'qid') {\n                return buildIntervalMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, 6, parseFloat(order.d), capacity);\n            }\n            if (order && order.scheduleType === 'qh') {\n                return buildIntervalMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, parseFloat(order.qHours), parseFloat(order.d), capacity);\n            }\n            return buildNursingMedicationScheduleStates(\n                startTime,\n                getNursingMedicationFrequency(order),\n                parseFloat(order && order.d),\n                capacity\n            );\n        }\n\n        function isOpenEndedMedicationOrder(order) {\n            if (!order) return false;\n            if (order.timingMode === 'protocol') {\n                return getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order) > 0 && !(parseInt(order.protocolMaxDoses, 10) > 0) && !normalizeNursingCellText(order.protocolStopAt);\n            }\n            if (order.scheduleType === 'bid' || order.scheduleType === 'tid' || order.scheduleType === 'qid' || order.scheduleType === 'qh') {\n                return !(parseFloat(order.d) > 0);\n            }\n            return getNursingMedicationFrequency(order) > 0 && !(parseFloat(order.d) > 0);\n        }\n\n        function captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell) {\n            if (!cell) return null;\n            var scheduledAt = cell.getAttribute('data-scheduled-at') || '';\n            if (!scheduledAt) {\n                if (cell.getAttribute('data-order-start-placeholder') === 'true') return null;\n                var legacyText = normalizeNursingCellText(cell.textContent);\n                return legacyText ? { legacyText: legacyText } : null;\n            }\n            return {\n                scheduledAt: scheduledAt,\n                actualAt: cell.getAttribute('data-actual-at') || '',\n                showDate: cell.getAttribute('data-show-date') === 'true'\n            };\n        }\n\n        function clearNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell) {\n            if (!cell) return;\n            cell.textContent = '';\n            cell.removeAttribute('data-scheduled-at');\n            cell.removeAttribute('data-actual-at');\n            cell.removeAttribute('data-show-date');\n            cell.removeAttribute('data-order-start-placeholder');\n            cell.classList.remove('nursing-med-given');\n            cell.setAttribute('title', currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ម៉ោងផ្តល់ឱសថ' : 'Medication administration time');\n        }\n\n        function renderNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell, state) {\n            clearNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell);\n            if (!state) return;\n            if (state.legacyText) {\n                cell.textContent = state.legacyText;\n                return;\n            }\n\n            var scheduled = new Date(state.scheduledAt);\n            var actual = state.actualAt ? new Date(state.actualAt) : null;\n            if (isNaN(scheduled.getTime())) return;\n            if (actual && isNaN(actual.getTime())) actual = null;\n\n            cell.setAttribute('data-scheduled-at', scheduled.toISOString());\n            if (actual) cell.setAttribute('data-actual-at', actual.toISOString());\n            cell.setAttribute('data-show-date', 'true');\n            cell.classList.toggle('nursing-med-given', !!actual);\n\n            var dose = document.createElement('div');\n            dose.className = 'nursing-med-dose';\n\n            var dateLabel = document.createElement('span');\n            dateLabel.className = 'nursing-med-dose-date';\n            dateLabel.textContent = formatNursingMedicationDate(actual || scheduled);\n            dose.appendChild(dateLabel);\n\n            var doseMain = document.createElement('span');\n            doseMain.className = 'nursing-med-dose-main';\n            var checkbox = document.createElement('input');\n            checkbox.type = 'checkbox';\n            checkbox.className = 'nursing-med-dose-check';\n            checkbox.checked = !!actual;\n            var timeLabel = document.createElement('span');\n            timeLabel.className = 'nursing-med-dose-time';\n            timeLabel.textContent = formatNursingMedicationTime(actual || scheduled);\n            doseMain.appendChild(checkbox);\n            doseMain.appendChild(timeLabel);\n            dose.appendChild(doseMain);\n            cell.appendChild(dose);\n\n            var plannedText = formatNursingMedicationDateTime(scheduled);\n            var actualText = actual ? 'បានផ្តល់ឱសថនៅម៉ោង ' + actualText : 'ធីកបន្ទាប់ពីផ្តល់ឱសថ ម៉ោងគ្រោង ' + plannedText);\n                cell.setAttribute('title', actual ? 'ម៉ោងគ្រោង៖ ' + plannedText + ' • ម៉ោងបានផ្តល់៖ ' + actualText + ' • ចុចពីរដងដើម្បីកែម៉ោងបានផ្តល់' : 'ម៉ោងគ្រោង៖ ' + plannedText + ' • ធីកបន្ទាប់ពីផ្តល់ឱសថ');\n            } else {\n                checkbox.setAttribute('aria-label', actual ? 'Scheduled: ' + plannedText + ' • Given: ' + actualText + ' • Double-click to edit the given time' : 'Scheduled: ' + plannedText + ' • Check after giving the dose');\n            }\n        }\n\n        function renderNursingMedicationStartDatePlaceholder(cell, effectiveAt) {\n            clearNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell);\n            var effectiveDate = effectiveAt ? new Date(effectiveAt) : null;\n            if (!effectiveDate || isNaN(effectiveDate.getTime())) return;\n            cell.setAttribute('data-order-start-placeholder', 'true');\n            var label = document.createElement('span');\n            label.className = 'nursing-med-start-date';\n            label.textContent = formatNursingMedicationDate(effectiveDate);\n            cell.appendChild(label);\n            cell.setAttribute('title', currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'កាលបរិច្ឆេទចាប់ផ្តើម • ចុចពីរដងដើម្បីចាប់ផ្តើមម៉ោងផ្តល់ឱសថ' : 'Effective date • Double-click to start the medication schedule');\n        }\n\n        function captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table) {\n            var section = getNursingMedicationSection(table);\n            if (!section) return table._nursingMedicationSchedules || {};\n            var columnCount = getNursingMedicationColumnCount(table);\n            var captured = {};\n            section.rows.forEach(function (row) {\n                var key = row.getAttribute('data-medication-key');\n                if (!key) return;\n                var segmentIndex = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-medication-segment-index'), 10) || 0;\n                if (!captured[key]) captured[key] = [];\n                getNursingTrailingCells(row, columnCount).forEach(function (cell, cellIndex) {\n                    var state = captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell);\n                    if (state) captured[key][segmentIndex * columnCount + cellIndex] = state;\n                });\n            });\n            Object.keys(captured).forEach(function (key) {\n                while (captured[key].length && !captured[key][captured[key].length - 1]) captured[key].pop();\n            });\n            table._nursingMedicationSchedules = Object.assign({}, table._nursingMedicationSchedules || {}, captured);\n            return table._nursingMedicationSchedules;\n        }\n\n        function persistNursingMedicationScheduleFromRow(row) {\n            var table = row && row.closest ? (table._nursingMedicationSchedules || {})\n                : captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table);\n            var usedLegacyKeys = {};\n            var descriptors = [];\n            orders.forEach(function (order) {\n                var schedule = getNursingMedicationSavedSchedule(savedSchedules, order, usedLegacyKeys);\n                if (!schedule.length && order.effectiveAt) {\n                    var effectiveStart = new Date(order.effectiveAt);\n                    if (!isNaN(effectiveStart.getTime())) {\n                        schedule = buildMedicationScheduleStates(effectiveStart, order, columnCount);\n                        savedSchedules[order.key] = schedule;\n                    }\n                }\n                var segmentCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(schedule.length / columnCount));\n                for (var segmentIndex = 0; segmentIndex < segmentCount; segmentIndex++) {\n                    descriptors.push({\n                        order: order,\n                        segmentIndex: segmentIndex,\n                        schedule: schedule.slice(segmentIndex * columnCount, (segmentIndex + 1) * columnCount)\n                    });\n                }\n            });\n\n            while (section.rows.length < Math.max(5, descriptors.length)) {\n                section.rows.push(createNursingMedicationRow(section, columnCount));\n            }\n            while (section.rows.length > Math.max(5, descriptors.length)) {\n                var lastRow = section.rows[section.rows.length - 1];\n                if (lastRow.getAttribute('data-generated-medication-row') !== 'true') break;\n                lastRow.remove();\n                section.rows.pop();\n            }\n\n            section.rows.forEach(function (row, rowIndex) {\n                var descriptor = descriptors[rowIndex] || null;\n                var order = descriptor ? descriptor.order : null;\n                var cells = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells);\n                var sourceCells = cells.slice(0, 3);\n                var timeCells = cells.slice(3);\n\n                sourceCells.forEach(function (cell) {\n                    cell.removeAttribute('contenteditable');\n                    cell.classList.remove('nursing-editable-cell');\n                    cell.classList.add('nursing-medication-source-cell');\n                });\n                timeCells.forEach(function (cell, timeIndex) {\n                    cell.removeAttribute('contenteditable');\n                    cell.removeAttribute('inputmode');\n                    cell.classList.remove('nursing-editable-cell');\n                    cell.classList.add('nursing-med-time-cell');\n                    var state = descriptor ? descriptor.schedule[timeIndex] : null;\n                    if (state && timeIndex === 0 && descriptor.segmentIndex > 0 && state.scheduledAt) {\n                        state = Object.assign({}, state, { showDate: true });\n                    }\n                    renderNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell, state);\n                });\n\n                row.classList.toggle('nursing-medication-continuation', !!(descriptor && descriptor.segmentIndex > 0));\n                if (order) {\n                    var frequency = getNursingMedicationFrequency(order);\n                    var intervalHours = order.scheduleType === row.setAttribute('data-medication-key', order.key);\n                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-segment-index', String(descriptor.segmentIndex));\n                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-frequency', String(frequency));\n                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-interval-hours', String(intervalHours));\n                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-duration-days', normalizeNursingCellText(order.d || ''));\n                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-timing-mode', order.timingMode || 'regular');\n                    row.setAttribute('data-medication-schedule-type', order.scheduleType || '');\n                    sourceCells[0].textContent = order.name;\n                    sourceCells[1].textContent = order.dose;\n                    sourceCells[2].textContent = getNursingMedicationRouteLabel(order.route);\n                    if (!descriptor.schedule.length && descriptor.segmentIndex === 0 && row._nursingMedicationOrder = null;\n                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-key');\n                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-segment-index');\n                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-frequency');\n                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-interval-hours');\n                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-duration-days');\n                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-timing-mode');\n                    row.removeAttribute('data-medication-schedule-type');\n                    sourceCells.forEach(function (cell) { cell.textContent = ''; });\n                }\n            });\n        }\n\n        function syncNursingMedicationOrders() {\n            var orders = collectNursingMedicationOrders();\n            document.querySelectorAll('#sub_nursing .vital-tbl').forEach(function (table) {\n                syncNursingMedicationTable(table, orders);\n            });\n        }\n\n        function getCurrentNursingTime() {\n            var now = new Date();\n            return String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');\n        }\n\n        function parseNursingMedicationTime(value, date) {\n            var enteredTime = normalizeNursingCellText(value);\n            var match = enteredTime.match(/^([01]?\\d|2[0-3])[:.]([0-5]\\d)$/);\n            if (!match) return null;\n            var result = new Date(date instanceof Date ? date.getTime() : Date.now());\n            result.setHours(parseInt(match[1], 10), parseInt(match[2], 10), 0, 0);\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        function showNursingMedicationTimeError() {\n            window.alert(currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'សូមបញ្ចូលម៉ោងតាមទម្រង់ HH:mm ឧទាហរណ៍ 08:30' : 'Enter the time as HH:mm, for example 08:30');\n        }\n\n        function startNursingMedicationSchedule(row) {\n            if (!row) return;\n            var table = row.closest('.vital-tbl');\n            var columnCount = getNursingMedicationColumnCount(table);\n            if (!columnCount || !table) return;\n\n            var enteredTime = window.prompt(\n                currentLang === 'khmer' ? 'ម៉ោងផ្តល់ឱសថលើកដំបូង (HH:mm)' : 'First medication administration time (HH:mm)',\n                getCurrentNursingTime()\n            );\n            if (enteredTime === null) return;\n            var startTime = parseNursingMedicationTime(enteredTime, new Date());\n            if (!startTime) {\n                showNursingMedicationTimeError();\n                return;\n            }\n\n            var order = row._nursingMedicationOrder;\n            if (!order) return;\n            var states = buildMedicationScheduleStates(startTime, order, columnCount);\n            if (order.timingMode === 'protocol' && states.length === 1 && !parseMedicationIntervalSequence(order.protocolIntervals).length && !getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order)) {\n                window.alert(currentLang === 'khmer'\n                    ? 'គ្រូពេទ្យមិនទាន់បញ្ចូលចន្លោះពេលក្នុងពិធីសារព្យាបាលទេ។ បានកត់ត្រាតែម៉ោងលើកដំបូង។'\n                    : 'No protocol intervals were entered by the doctor. Only the first administration time was recorded.');\n            }\n            var store = captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table);\n            store[order.key] = states;\n            table._nursingMedicationSchedules = store;\n            syncNursingMedicationTable(table, collectNursingMedicationOrders(), true);\n        }\n\n        function extendOpenEndedNursingMedicationSchedule(row, completedCell) {\n            var table = row && row.closest ? row.closest('.vital-tbl') : null;\n            var order = row ? row._nursingMedicationOrder : null;\n            if (!table || !order || !isOpenEndedMedicationOrder(order)) return;\n            var columnCount = getNursingMedicationColumnCount(table);\n            var segmentIndex = parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-medication-segment-index'), 10) || 0;\n            var cellIndex = getNursingTrailingCells(row, columnCount).indexOf(completedCell);\n            var store = captureNursingMedicationSchedules(table);\n            var states = store[order.key] || [];\n            var globalIndex = segmentIndex * columnCount + cellIndex;\n            if (globalIndex !== states.length - 1 || !states[globalIndex] || !states[globalIndex].actualAt || states.length >= 256) return;\n\n            var previousTime = new Date(states[states.length - 1].scheduledAt);\n            var previousDateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(previousTime);\n            for (var index = 0; index < columnCount && states.length < 256; index++) {\n                previousTime = getNextMedicationScheduledTime(previousTime, order);\n                if (!previousTime) break;\n                var dateKey = getNursingMedicationDateKey(previousTime);\n                states.push({\n                    scheduledAt: previousTime.toISOString(),\n                    actualAt: '',\n                    showDate: dateKey !== previousDateKey\n                });\n                previousDateKey = dateKey;\n            }\n            store[order.key] = states;\n            table._nursingMedicationSchedules = store;\n            syncNursingMedicationTable(table, collectNursingMedicationOrders(), true);\n        }\n\n        function getNextMedicationScheduledTime(previousTime, order) {\n            if (!(previousTime instanceof Date) || isNaN(previousTime.getTime()) || !order) return null;\n            if (order.timingMode === 'protocol') {\n                var protocolMinutes = getProtocolRepeatMinutes(order);\n                return protocolMinutes > 0 ? new Date(previousTime.getTime() + protocolMinutes * 60000) : null;\n            }\n            if (order.scheduleType === 'bid' || order.scheduleType === 'tid') {\n                var wardTimes = getMedicationWardTimes(order.scheduleType);\n                for (var dayOffset = 0; dayOffset < 3; dayOffset++) {\n                    for (var timeIndex = 0; timeIndex < wardTimes.length; timeIndex++) {\n                        var candidate = new Date(previousTime.getFullYear(), previousTime.getMonth(), previousTime.getDate() + dayOffset, wardTimes[timeIndex][0], wardTimes[timeIndex][1], 0, 0);\n                        if (candidate.getTime() > previousTime.getTime()) return candidate;\n                    }\n                }\n                return null;\n            }\n            var intervalHours = order.scheduleType === 'qid'\n                ? 6\n                : (order.scheduleType === 'qh' ? parseFloat(order.qHours) : getNursingMedicationIntervalHours(getNursingMedicationFrequency(order)));\n            return intervalHours > 0 ? new Date(previousTime.getTime() + intervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000) : null;\n        }\n\n        function updateNursingMedicationGivenState(checkbox) {\n            var cell = checkbox && checkbox.closest ? checkbox.closest('td.nursing-med-time-cell') : null;\n            if (!cell) return;\n            var state = captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell);\n            if (!state || !state.scheduledAt) return;\n            state.actualAt = checkbox.checked ? new Date().toISOString() : '';\n            renderNursingMedicationDoseCell(cell, state);\n            var row = cell.closest('tr[data-medication-key]');\n            persistNursingMedicationScheduleFromRow(row);\n            if (checkbox.checked) extendOpenEndedNursingMedicationSchedule(row, cell);\n        }\n\n        function editNursingMedicationGivenTime(cell) {\n            var state = captureNursingMedicationCellState(cell);\n            if (!state || !state.actualAt) return;\n            var actualTime = new Date(state.actualAt);\n            var enteredTime = window.prompt(\n                currentLang === 'khmer' ?     }\n\n        function initializeNursingCareCanvas(canvas) {\n            if (!canvas || canvas.getAttribute('data-nursing-canvas-ready')) return;\n            canvas.setAttribute('data-nursing-canvas-ready', 'true');\n            var page = canvas.closest('.nursing-care-wound-page');\n            var context = canvas.getContext('2d');\n            if (!page || !context) return;\n            var colorControl = page.querySelector('[data-nursing-brush-color]');\n            var sizeControl = page.querySelector('[data-nursing-brush-size]');\n            var clearControl = page.querySelector('[data-nursing-clear-canvas]');\n            var undoControl = page.querySelector('[data-nursing-undo-canvas]');\n            var bodyImage = new Image();\n            var bodyImageReady = false;\n            /* Each stroke is stored as { points: [{x,y},...], color, width } */\n            var strokes = [];\n            var currentStroke = null;\n            var isDrawing = false;\n\n            function getPoint(event) {\n                var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();\n                return {\n                    x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width),\n                    y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height)\n                };\n            }\n\n            function drawStroke(stroke) {\n                if (!stroke.points || stroke.points.length < 2) return;\n                context.beginPath();\n                context.moveTo(stroke.points[0].x, stroke.points[0].y);\n                for (var i = 1; i < stroke.points.length; i++) {\n                    context.lineTo(stroke.points[i].x, stroke.points[i].y);\n                }\n                context.strokeStyle = stroke.color;\n                context.lineWidth = stroke.width;\n                context.lineCap = 'round';\n                context.lineJoin = 'round';\n                context.stroke();\n            }\n\n            function redrawCanvas() {\n                context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);\n                if (bodyImageReady && bodyImage.width && bodyImage.height) {\n                    var scale = Math.min(canvas.width / bodyImage.width, canvas.height / bodyImage.height);\n                    var imageWidth = bodyImage.width * scale;\n                    var imageHeight = bodyImage.height * scale;\n                    context.drawImage(\n                        bodyImage,\n                        (canvas.width - imageWidth) / 2,\n                        (canvas.height - imageHeight) / 2,\n                        imageWidth,\n                        imageHeight\n                    );\n                }\n                strokes.forEach(drawStroke);\n                if (isDrawing && currentStroke) {\n                    drawStroke(currentStroke);\n                }\n            }\n\n            function startDrawing(event) {\n                if (event.button !== undefined && event.button !== 0) return;\n                isDrawing = true;\n                var pt = getPoint(event);\n                currentStroke = {\n                    points: [pt],\n                    color: colorControl ? colorControl.value : '#ef4444',\n                    width: sizeControl ? Number(sizeControl.value) || 3 : 3\n                };\n                if (canvas.setPointerCapture && event.pointerId !== undefined) {\n                    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { }\n                }\n                event.preventDefault();\n            }\n\n            function moveDrawing(event) {\n                if (!isDrawing || !currentStroke) return;\n                currentStroke.points.push(getPoint(event));\n                redrawCanvas();\n                event.preventDefault();\n            }\n\n            function stopDrawing(event) {\n                if (!isDrawing || !currentStroke) return;\n                currentStroke.points.push(getPoint(event));\n                if (currentStroke.points.length >= 2) {\n                    strokes.push(currentStroke);\n                }\n                isDrawing = false;\n                currentStroke = null;\n                if (canvas.releasePointerCapture && event.pointerId !== undefined) {\n                    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { }\n                }\n                redrawCanvas();\n                event.preventDefault();\n            }\n\n            canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', startDrawing);\n            canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', moveDrawing);\n            canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', stopDrawing);\n            canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', function (event) {\n                if (!isDrawing) return;\n                isDrawing = false;\n                currentStroke = null;\n                redrawCanvas();\n                event.preventDefault();\n            });\n            if (undoControl) {\n                undoControl.addEventListener('click', function () {\n                    if (strokes.length) strokes.pop();\n                    currentStroke = null;\n                    isDrawing = false;\n                    redrawCanvas();\n                });\n            }\n            if (clearControl) {\n                clearControl.addEventListener('click', function () {\n                    strokes = [];\n                    currentStroke = null;\n                    isDrawing = false;\n                    redrawCanvas();\n                });\n            }\n            bodyImage.onload = function () {\n                bodyImageReady = true;\n                redrawCanvas();\n            };\n            bodyImage.onerror = function () {\n                bodyImageReady = false;\n                redrawCanvas();\n            };\n            bodyImage.src = '/public/anatomy-position.png';\n            redrawCanvas();\n        }\n\n        function initializeNursingCarePages() {\n     function ensureNursingChartCapacity(table, recordCount) {\n            var graphRows = table.querySelectorAll('tr.graph-tr');\n            if (!graphRows.length) return;\n            var estimatedWidth - 2, desiredX));\n            var chosenY = options.y;\n\n            for (var offsetIndex = 0; offsetIndex < offsets.length; offsetIndex++) {\n                var candidateY = Math.max(options.bounds.top + estimatedHeight / 2, Math.min(options.bounds.bottom - estimatedHeight / 2, options.y + offsets[offsetIndex]));\n                var candidateRect = {\n                    left: chosenX,\n                    right: chosenX + estimatedWidth,\n                    top: candidateY - estimatedHeight / 2,\n                    bottom: candidateY + estimatedHeight / 2\n                };\n                var overlaps = registry.some(function (existing) {\n                    return !(candidateRect.right + 2 < existing.left || candidateRect.left - 2 > existing.right || candidateRect.bottom + 2 < existing.top || candidateRect.top - 2 > existing.bottom);\n                });\n                if (!overlaps || offsetIndex === offsets.length - 1) {\n                    chosenY = candidateY;\n                    registry.push(candidateRect);\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n\n            if (Math.abs(chosenY - options.y) > 1) {\n                svg.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {\n                    x1: options.x + 4,\n                    y1: options.y,\n                    x2: chosenX - 2,\n                    y2: chosenY,\n                    stroke: options.color,\n                    class: 'nursing-label-leader ' + (options.className || '')\n                }));\n            }\n\n            var text = nursingSvgElement('text', {\n                x: chosenX,\n                y: chosenY,\n                fill: options.color,\n                class: 'nursing-series-label ' + (options.className || ''),\n                'text-anchor': 'start',\n                'dominant-baseline': 'middle'\n            });\n            text.textContent = textValue;\n            svg.appendChild(text);\n        }\n\n        function nursingYForScale(value, scaleValues, baselinePositions) {\n            if (!scaleValues.length || scaleValues.length !== baselinePositions.length) return 0;\n            var numericValue = nursingNumber(value);\n            if (numericValue === null) return baselinePositions[baselinePositions.length - 1];\n            if (numericValue >= scaleValues[0]) return baselinePositions[0];\n            if (numericValue <= scaleValues[scaleValues.length - 1]) return baselinePositions[baselinePositions.length - 1];\n\n            for (var index = 0; index < scaleValues.length - 1; index++) {\n                var upperValue = scaleValues[index];\n                var lowerValue = scaleValues[index + 1];\n                if (numericValue <= upperValue && numericValue >= lowerValue) {\n                    var ratio = (upperValue - numericValue) / (upperValue - lowerValue);\n                    return baselinePositions[index] + ((baselinePositions[index + 1] - baselinePositions[index]) * ratio);\n                }\n            }\n            return baselinePositions[baselinePositions.length - 1];\n        }\n\n        function drawNursingLineSeries(svg, records, xPositions, yForValue, fieldName, options, labelRegistry, bounds) {\n            var previousPoint = null;\n            records.forEach(function (record, index) {\n                var value = record[fieldName];\n                if (value === null || xPositions[index] === undefined) {\n                    previousPoint = null;\n                    return;\n                }\n\n                var assessment = assessVitalValue(fieldName, value, getExactAge());\n                var point = { x: xPositions[index], y: yForValue(value) };\n                if (previousPoint) {\n                    svg.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {\n                        x1: previousPoint.x,\n                        y1: previousPoint.y,\n                        x2: point.x,\n                        y2: point.y,\n                        stroke: options.color,\n                        'stroke-width': 2,\n                        'stroke-linecap': 'round',\n                        'stroke-dasharray': options.dashArray || '',\n                        class: options.seriesClass\n                    }));\n                }\n\n                var marker;\n                if (options.marker === 'square') {\n                    marker = nursingSvgElement('rect', {\n                        x: point.x - 3.2, y: point.y - 3.2, width: 6.4, height: 6.4,\n                        fill: options.color, stroke: options.color, 'stroke-width': 1,\n                        class: 'marker-pulse'\n                    });\n                } else {\n                    marker = nursingSvgElement('circle', {\n                        cx: point.x, cy: point.y, r: 3.5,\n                        fill: '#ffffff', stroke: options.color, 'stroke-width': 2,\n                        class: 'marker-temp'\n                    });\n                }\n                addNursingSvgTitle(marker, options.label + ': ' + value + (fieldName === 'temp' ? '! ' : '') + (fieldName === 'temp' ? 'T ' + value + '°' : 'P ' + value),\n                        color: assessment.abnormal ? ' : '') + 'BP ' + record.bp_sys + '/' + record.bp_dia,\n                        color: color,\n                        className: 'series-bp',\n                        bounds: bounds,\n                        offsets: [0, -10, 10, -19, 19, -28, 28]\n                    });\n                }\n            });\n        }\n\n        function drawNursingValueGroups(svg, records, xPositions, yForTemperature, yForPulseOrBp, registry, bounds) {\n            records.forEach(function (record, index) {\n                if (xPositions[index] === undefined) return;\n\n                var entries = [];\n                if (record.bp_sys !== null && record.bp_dia !== null) {\n                    var bpAssessment = classifyNursingBloodPressure(record.bp_sys, record.bp_dia);\n                    entries.push({\n                        text: (bpAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#0088CC',\n                        className: 'series-bp',\n                        targetY: (yForPulseOrBp(record.bp_sys) + yForPulseOrBp(record.bp_dia)) / 2\n                    });\n                }\n                if (record.pulse !== null) {\n                    var pulseAssessment = assessVitalValue('pulse', record.pulse, getExactAge());\n                    entries.push({\n                        text: (pulseAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'P: ' + record.pulse,\n                        color: pulseAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#2563eb',\n                        className: 'series-pulse',\n                        targetY: yForPulseOrBp(record.pulse)\n                    });\n                }\n                if (record.temp !== null) {\n                    var tempAssessment = assessVitalValue('temp', record.temp, getExactAge());\n                    entries.push({\n                        text: (tempAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'T: ' + record.temp + '°C',\n                        color: tempAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#f97316',\n                        className: 'series-temp',\n                        targetY: yForTemperature(record.temp)\n                    });\n                }\n                if (!entries.length) return;\n\n                var lineHeight = 11;\n                var boxPaddingX = 4;\n                var boxPaddingY = 3;\n                var boxHeight = (entries.length * lineHeight) + (boxPaddingY * 2);\n                var longestText = entries.reduce(function (longest, entry) {\n                    return entry.text.length > longest.length ? entry.text : longest;\n                }, '');\n                var boxWidth = Math.max(34, (longestText.length * 4.6) + (boxPaddingX * 2));\n                var desiredX = xPositions[index] + 8;\n                var boxX = Math.max(bounds.left + 2, Math.min(bounds.right - boxWidth - 2, desiredX));\n                var averageTargetY = entries.reduce(function (total, entry) { return total + entry.targetY; }, 0) / entries.length;\n                var preferredTop = averageTargetY - (boxHeight / 2);\n                var verticalOffsets = [0, -boxHeight - 4, boxHeight + 4, -(boxHeight * 2) - 8, (boxHeight * 2) + 8];\n                var chosenTop = Math.max(bounds.top + 2, Math.min(bounds.bottom - boxHeight - 2, preferredTop));\n                var chosenRect = null;\n\n                for (var offsetIndex = 0; offsetIndex < verticalOffsets.length; offsetIndex++) {\n                    var candidateTop = Math.max(bounds.top + 2, Math.min(bounds.bottom - boxHeight - 2, preferredTop + verticalOffsets[offsetIndex]));\n                    var candidateRect = {\n                        left: boxX,\n                        right: boxX + boxWidth,\n                        top: candidateTop,\n                        bottom: candidateTop + boxHeight\n                    };\n                    var overlaps = registry.some(function (existing) {\n                        return !(candidateRect.right + 3 < existing.left || candidateRect.left - 3 > existing.right || candidateRect.bottom + 3 < existing.top || candidateRect.top - 3 > existing.bottom);\n                    });\n                    if (!overlaps || offsetIndex === verticalOffsets.length - 1) {\n                        chosenTop = candidateTop;\n                        chosenRect = candidateRect;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (chosenRect) registry.push(chosenRect);\n\n                var group = nursingSvgElement('g', { class: 'nursing-value-group' });\n                entries.forEach(function (entry, entryIndex) {\n                    var labelY = chosenTop + boxPaddingY + (entryIndex * lineHeight) + (lineHeight / 2);\n                    group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('line', {\n                        x1: xPositions[index] + 4,\n                        y1: entry.targetY,\n                        x2: boxX - 2,\n                        y2: labelY,\n                        stroke: entry.color,\n                        class: 'nursing-value-leader ' + entry.className\n                    }));\n                });\n                group.appendChild(nursingSvgElement('rect', {\n                    x: boxX,\n                    y: chosenTop,\n                    width: boxWidth,\n                    height: boxHeight,\n                    rx: 2,\n                    ry: 2,\n                    class: 'nursing-value-box'\n                }));\n                entries.forEach(function (entry, entryIndex) {\n                    var label = nursingSvgElement('text', {\n                        x: boxX + boxPaddingX,\n                        y: chosenTop + boxPaddingY + (entryIndex * lineHeight) + (lineHeight / 2),\n                        fill: entry.color,\n                        class: 'nursing-value-label ' + entry.className,\n                        'text-anchor': 'start',\n                        'dominant-baseline': 'middle'\n                    });\n                    label.textContent = entry.text;\n                    group.appendChild(label);\n                });\n                svg.appendChild(group);\n            });\n        }\n\n        function drawNursingCompactLabels(svg, records, xPositions, yForTemperature, yForPulseOrBp, registry, bounds) {\n            records.forEach(function (record, index) {\n                var x = xPositions[index];\n                if (x === undefined) return;\n\n                if (record.bp_sys !== null && record.bp_dia !== null) {\n                    var bpAssessment = classifyNursingBloodPressure(record.bp_sys, record.bp_dia);\n                    addNursingValueLabel(svg, registry, {\n                        x: x,\n                        y: (yForPulseOrBp(record.bp_sys) + yForPulseOrBp(record.bp_dia)) / 2,\n                        text: (bpAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'BP ' + record.bp_sys + '/' + record.bp_dia,\n                        color: bpAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#0088CC',\n                        className: 'series-bp',\n                        bounds: bounds,\n                        offsets: [0, -10, 10, -19, 19, -28, 28]\n                    });\n                }\n\n                if (record.pulse !== null) {\n                    var pulseAssessment = assessVitalValue('pulse', record.pulse, getExactAge());\n                    addNursingValueLabel(svg, registry, {\n                        x: x,\n                        y: yForPulseOrBp(record.pulse),\n                        text: (pulseAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'P ' + record.pulse,\n                        color: pulseAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#2563eb',\n                        className: 'series-pulse',\n                        bounds: bounds,\n                        offsets: [0, 10, -10, 19, -19, 28, -28]\n                    });\n                }\n\n                if (record.temp !== null) {\n                    var tempAssessment = assessVitalValue('temp', record.temp, getExactAge());\n                    addNursingValueLabel(svg, registry, {\n                        x: x,\n                        y: yForTemperature(record.temp),\n                        text: (tempAssessment.abnormal ? '! ' : '') + 'T ' + record.temp + '°',\n                        color: tempAssessment.abnormal ? '#dc2626' : '#f97316',\n                        className: 'series-temp',\n                        bounds: bounds,\n                        offsets: [0, -10, 10, -19, 19, -28, 28]\n                    });\n                }\n            });\n        }\n\n        function renderNursingNumericRow(table, selector, records, fieldName) {\n            var row = table.querySelector(selector);\n            if (!row) return;\n            var valueCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells, 1);\n            valueCells.forEach(function (cell, index) {\n                cell.innerHTML = '';\n                cell.removeAttribute('title');\n                var record = records[index];\n                if (!record || record[fieldName] === null || record[fieldName] === undefined) return;\n\n                var assessment = assessVitalValue(fieldName, record[fieldName], getExactAge());\n                var value = document.createElement('span');\n                value.className = 'nursing-vital-value ' + (assessment.abnormal ? 'vital-abnormal' : 'vital-normal');\n                value.textContent = record[fieldName];\n                cell.appendChild(value);\n                if (assessment.range) {\n                    cell.title = (assessment.abnormal ? 'Outside range: ' : 'Normal range: ') + assessment.range[0] + '–' + assessment.range[1];\n                }\n            });\n        }\n\n        function renderNursingVitalChart(table, records) {\n            ensureNursingChartCapacity(table, records.length);\n\n            var stage = table.parentElement && table.parentElement.classList.contains('nursing-chart-stage') ? table.parentElement : null;\n            if (!stage) {\n                stage = document.createElement('div');\n                stage.className = 'nursing-chart-stage';\n                table.parentNode.insertBefore(stage, table);\n                stage.appendChild(table);\n            }\n            buildNursingChartLegend(stage.parentNode, records.length);\n\n            var oldOverlay = stage.querySelector('.nursing-chart-overlay');\n            if (oldOverlay) oldOverlay.remove();\n\n            renderNursingNumericRow(table, 'tr.nursing-resp-row', records, 'resp');\n            renderNursingNumericRow(table, 'tr.nursing-spo2-row', records, 'spo2');\n\n            var rows = table.tBodies && table.tBodies[0] ? table.tBodies[0].rows : [];\n            if (rows.length < 16 || !stage.getBoundingClientRect().width) return;\n\n            var timeRow = rows[0];\n            timeRow.classList.add('nursing-chart-time-row');\n            var timeCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(timeRow.cells, 1);\n            timeCells.forEach(function (cell, index) {\n                cell.innerHTML = '';\n                if (records[index]) {\n                    var label = document.createElement('span');\n                    label.className = 'nursing-time-label';\n                    label.textContent = formatNursingChartTime(records[index]);\n                    label.title = records[index].source === 'triage' ? 'Triage' : 'Evolution';\n                    cell.appendChild(label);\n                }\n            });\n\n            var graphRows = Array.prototype.slice.call(table.querySelectorAll('tr.graph-tr'));\n            if (!graphRows.length) return;\n            var firstGraphCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(graphRows[0].querySelectorAll('.graph-td'));\n            var lastGraphCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(graphRows[graphRows.length - 1].querySelectorAll('.graph-td'));\n            if (!firstGraphCells.length || !lastGraphCells.length) return;\n\n            var stageRect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();\n            var topRect = firstGraphCells[0].getBoundingClientRect();\n            var bottomRect = lastGraphCells[0].getBoundingClientRect();\n            var graphTop = topRect.top - stageRect.top;\n            var graphBottom = bottomRect.bottom - stageRect.top;\n            var graphHeight = graphBottom - graphTop;\n            if (graphHeight <= 0) return;\n\n            var xPositions = firstGraphCells.map(function (cell) {\n                var rect = cell.getBoundingClientRect();\n                return rect.left - stageRect.left + (rect.width / 2);\n            });\n\n            var overlay = nursingSvgElement('svg', {\n                class: 'nursing-chart-overlay',\n                width: stage.scrollWidth,\n                height: stage.scrollHeight,\n                viewBox: '0 0 ' + stage.scrollWidth + ' ' + stage.scrollHeight,\n                'aria-hidden': 'true'\n            });\n            stage.appendChild(overlay);\n\n            // Each printed scale number is the exact value at the vertical\n            // centre of its cell. The borders immediately above and below a\n            // BP/PR number are +10 and -10; each minor division is 4 units.\n            // A temperature number is centred in its two-row cell, whose top\n            // and bottom borders are +0.5 °C and -0.5 °C; each temperature\n            // division is 0.1 °C. Using the live cell centres keeps markers\n            // precisely aligned even when screen or print sizing changes.\n            var bpScaleValues = [];\n            var bpScalePositions = [];\n            var pulseScaleValues = [];\n            var pulseScalePositions = [];\n            var temperatureScaleValues = [];\n            var temperatureScalePositions = [];\n\n            graphRows.forEach(function (row) {\n                var bpCell = row.cells[0];\n                var pulseCell = row.cells[1];\n                var bpValue = bpCell ? nursingNumber(bpCell.textContent) : null;\n                var pulseValue = pulseCell ? nursingNumber(pulseCell.textContent) : null;\n\n                if (bpValue !== null) {\n                    var bpRect = bpCell.getBoundingClientRect();\n                    bpScaleValues.push(bpValue);\n                    bpScalePositions.push(bpRect.top - stageRect.top + (bpRect.height / 2));\n                }\n                if (pulseValue !== null) {\n                    var pulseRect = pulseCell.getBoundingClientRect();\n                    pulseScaleValues.push(pulseValue);\n                    pulseScalePositions.push(pulseRect.top - stageRect.top + (pulseRect.height / 2));\n                }\n\n                var temperatureCell = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.cells, 2).find(function (cell) {\n                    return !cell.classList.contains('graph-td') && nursingNumber(cell.textContent) !== null;\n                });\n                if (temperatureCell) {\n                    var temperatureValue = nursingNumber(temperatureCell.textContent);\n                    var temperatureRect = temperatureCell.getBoundingClientRect();\n                    temperatureScaleValues.push(temperatureValue);\n                    temperatureScalePositions.push(temperatureRect.top - stageRect.top + (temperatureRect.height / 2));\n                }\n            });\n\n            // Add the visible outer borders as half-interval anchors so the\n            // complete first and last scale blocks interpolate correctly.\n            if (bpScaleValues.length) {\n                bpScaleValues.unshift(bpScaleValues[0] + 10);\n                bpScalePositions.unshift(graphTop);\n                bpScaleValues.push(bpScaleValues[bpScaleValues.length - 1] - 10);\n                bpScalePositions.push(graphBottom);\n            }\n            if (pulseScaleValues.length) {\n                pulseScaleValues.unshift(pulseScaleValues[0] + 10);\n                pulseScalePositions.unshift(graphTop);\n                pulseScaleValues.push(pulseScaleValues[pulseScaleValues.length - 1] - 10);\n                pulseScalePositions.push(graphBottom);\n            }\n            if (temperatureScaleValues.length) {\n                temperatureScaleValues.unshift(temperatureScaleValues[0] + 0.5);\n                temperatureScalePositions.unshift(graphTop);\n                temperatureScaleValues.push(temperatureScaleValues[temperatureScaleValues.length - 1] - 0.5);\n                temperatureScalePositions.push(graphBottom);\n            }\n\n            var yForBloodPressure = function (value) {\n                return nursingYForScale(value, bpScaleValues, bpScalePositions);\n            };\n            var yForPulse = function (value) {\n                return nursingYForScale(value, pulseScaleValues, pulseScalePositions);\n            };\n            var yForTemperature = function (value) {\n                return nursingYForScale(value, temperatureScaleValues, temperatureScalePositions);\n            };\n            var labelRegistry = [];\n            var labelBounds = {\n                left: xPositions[0] ? xPositions[0] - (firstGraphCells[0].getBoundingClientRect().width / 2) : 0,\n                right: xPositions.length ? xPositions[xPositions.length - 1] + (firstGraphCells[firstGraphCells.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect().width / 2) : stage.scrollWidth,\n                top: graphTop,\n                bottom: graphBottom\n            };\n\n            // Keep all three plotted vital signs in their own horizontal lane\n            // inside every date/time column so their markers never cover one another.\n            // Pulse uses the left lane, blood pressure the centre lane, and\n            // temperature the right lane.  The inset is calculated per cell so\n            // the separation remains correct on screen and when the table shrinks\n            // to fit the printed page.\n            var pulseXPositions = [];\n            var bloodPressureXPositions = [];\n            var temperatureXPositions = [];\n            firstGraphCells.forEach(function (cell) {\n                var rect = cell.getBoundingClientRect();\n                var cellLeft = rect.left - stageRect.left;\n                var safeInset = Math.max(5, Math.min(12, rect.width * 0.18));\n\n                pulseXPositions.push(cellLeft + safeInset);\n                bloodPressureXPositions.push(cellLeft + (rect.width / 2));\n                temperatureXPositions.push(cellLeft + rect.width - safeInset);\n            });\n\n            drawNursingLineSeries(overlay, records, temperatureXPositions, yForTemperature, 'temp', {\n                color: '#f97316', label: 'Temperature', marker: 'circle', seriesClass: 'series-temp', dashArray: '', showLabels: false\n            }, labelRegistry, labelBounds);\n            drawNursingLineSeries(overlay, records, pulseXPositions, yForPulse, 'pulse', {\n                color: '#2563eb', label: 'Pulse', marker: 'square', seriesClass: 'series-pulse', dashArray: '6 4', showLabels: false\n            }, labelRegistry, labelBounds);\n            drawNursingBloodPressure(overlay, records, bloodPressureXPositions, yForBloodPressure, labelRegistry, labelBounds, false);\n        }\n\n        function renderNursingVitalCharts() {\n            var records = getNursingVitalRecords();\n            document.querySelectorAll('#sub_nursing .vital-tbl').forEach(function (table) {\n                renderNursingVitalChart(table, records);\n            });\n            refreshNursingInteractiveTables();\n        }\n\n        function scheduleNursingChartRender() {\n            var subNursing = document.getElementById('sub_nursing');\n            if (subNursing && (subNursing.hidden || subNursing.style.display === 'none' || subNursing.offsetParent === null)) {\n                return;\n            }\n            if (nursingChartRenderTimer) clearTimeout(nursingChartRenderTimer);\n            nursingChartRenderTimer = setTimeout(function () {\n                nursingChartRenderTimer = null;\n                renderNursingVitalCharts();\n            }, 50);\n        }\n\n        function printNursingForm(formName) {\n            renderNursingVitalCharts();\n            return window.printEmrReport({selectors:[formName === 'maternity' ?
